Welcome to the financial frontier of limitless possibilities - welcome to Zolve. We're not just a fintech; we're architects of a financial revolution, crafting a narrative that transcends borders. At Zolve, we believe in rewriting the rules of finance to empower global citizens, nomads, and dreamers to navigate the world without constraints.
Zolve is the world's first cross border neo-bank which helps migrants get access to credit in the new country based on their home country credit score. As we continue to grow into multiple geographies, product lines and customer segments, we are seeking a dynamic individual to join us and support our journey.

Role: Business Development Associates– Study Abroad Partnership
Location: Pan India( Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kerala, Delhi, Mumbai, Gujarat, Punjab, Nepal).

Build, manage, and nurture relationships with study abroad affiliates, counsellors,  loan providers, and visa counsellors.
Drive acquisition of student leads through affiliate and counsellor networks.
Pitch and sell Zolve’s financial solutions (Education Loans, Credit Cards, Forex

 Act as a trusted partner to affiliates, ensuring smooth coordination and       high-quality lead flow.
Meet and exceed monthly/quarterly sales and partnership targets, aligned with reward structures.
Conduct regular partner visits, presentations, and training sessions.
Represent Zolve at industry events, student fairs, and partner activations
QUALIFICATIONS
Education : Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred.
Experience : 
2–5 years in business development, partnerships, or sales within the study abroad, education, or financial services industry. 
Prior experience in managing affiliates, counsellors, loan partners, or visa consultants is essential. 
A proven track record in selling to international students or immigrants will be a strong plus. 
Hands-on with CRM tools like Salesforce, Zoho and Excel. 
Excellent communication and negotiation skills in English; knowledge of a regional language is an added advantage. 
Comfortable with travel-intensive roles and dynamic fieldwork. 
Target-driven, goal-oriented, and able to thrive in a high-performance culture.

Company Description
Swiggy is India’s leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fueled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India.
Job Description
About the Role
Swiggy is looking for an experienced professional to build and manage strategic partnerships with large institutions, enterprises and key business ecosystems across our priority markets.
The role will involve identifying opportunities, building relationships with senior stakeholders, developing partnership frameworks and working closely with internal teams to create solutions that enhance Swiggy’s presence and engagement across important consumer and business ecosystems.
This is a highly collaborative, stakeholder-facing role requiring strong relationship-building, commercial understanding and the ability to navigate complex organization.
We are looking for someone who is well-networked, commercially astute and highly effective at building relationships and getting things done.
The ideal candidate will be comfortable operating in ambiguous environments, engaging with senior stakeholders and creating partnerships that deliver tangible business outcomes.
Experience across multiple markets, particularly Delhi-NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Chennai, would be an advantage.
Key Responsibilities
Identify and develop strategic relationships with large enterprises, institutions and business ecosystems across key cities.
Build relationships with senior decision-makers and relevant stakeholders across organization.
Understand partner requirements and develop mutually beneficial partnership models.
Lead discussions and negotiations through to closure and implementation.
Work closely with city, operations, commercial, legal and other internal teams to ensure successful execution of partnerships.
Develop a strong understanding of local market dynamics and identify opportunities to strengthen Swiggy’s presence across priority ecosystems.
Build scalable partnership approaches that can be replicated across markets.
Track partnership performance and identify opportunities for deeper engagement and expansion.
Represent Swiggy in senior-level external engagements and build long-term institutional relationships.
Qualifications
What We’re Looking For
12-14 years of experience in strategic partnerships, institutional relationships, business development, corporate real estate, enterprise partnerships, facility management, consulting or related fields.
Experience working with large enterprises, institutions or complex stakeholder ecosystems.
Strong relationship-building and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior decision-makers.
Demonstrated ability to navigate complex organization and bring multiple stakeholders together.
Strong commercial and problem-solving orientation.
Excellent communication and executive presence.
Ability to operate independently across multiple cities and manage a diverse stakeholder landscape.
A strong bias for execution and demonstrated ability to take partnerships from initial conversations to implementation.
Additional Information
Visit our tech blogs to learn more about some the challenges we deal with: https://medium.com/swiggy-bytes
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.
